name: Close apps you leave
description: An app you walked away from is closed a while later, so the TV gets its memory back.
about: webOS keeps an app you left in memory. On a TV with about a gigabyte for everything, two or three of those are enough to make the whole screen slow: the kernel starts swapping to the TV's own storage and never stops. This add-on watches which app is in front, and when you go somewhere else it closes the one you left after the wait you choose (10 seconds to 5 minutes). Come back before the wait is over and nothing happens. On its page you tick the apps that must stay open; the launcher's own apps, LG's Home, the Inputs, Live TV and the Homebrew Channel's apps, such as the Hyperion loaders for ambilight, are never closed.
